lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Review present-tense small talk with greetings, routine details, and simple questions.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A short friendly exchange by the office coffee machine.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Maintaining simple small talk for several turns.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik meet at fika, ask how the day is going, mention today's routine, and end with a friendly see-you-later.

main_focus.name: present-tense small talk review
main_focus.description: Combine simple present statements, basic V2, and simple questions in one natural exchange.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use 4-6 clear present-tense clauses and at least 3 simple questions.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use familiar Week 1 chunks to make the dialogue feel like a realistic end-of-week review.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker starts with a greeting and asks how things are.
dialogue_shape.middle: They exchange a few present-tense details about today, fika, and after-work routine.
dialogue_shape.ending: They close naturally and say they will see each other later.

target_complexity.repetition: spiral Week 1 patterns without introducing new grammar

focus: how the speakers say they are
what one speaker is doing today

sentence_focus: one sentence with idag and V2
one sentence with a fika word
